orientations.intent: Determine whether these tools (repo, tests, git, episodes) can publish a checklist to a remote release system.

final_message: No — none of the available tools (repo, tests, git, episodes) support publishing a checklist to a remote release system. The capability check confirms this action is unavailable in the reachable set of tools; they only cover repository, testing, git, and episode-history operations, not remote release publishing.
